key.name: languages
key.description: The languages whose strings of the apps' desktop files are searched, in order: when a query matches equally well in two languages, the one that comes first ranks higher. "session" is the session's language, and is always searched: it's put first if it's missing. "default" is the apps' default language (usually English): their strings without a locale. Any other entry is a locale name, like "de" or "pt_BR".

key.name: handle-settings-provider
key.summary: Find Settings panels in every language
key.description: Whether the Settings section of the search results also lists the Settings panels that match in the other languages of the "languages" key, after the ones Settings finds in the session's language. It has no effect when the Shell doesn't search Settings, e.g. when parental controls block the Settings app.
